content: Kuhika kwa Nhuki ghwa Chapanga
Palihikite linjubha lya kikubhukubhu kya Pendekositi, bhaanhyubhalilite Yesu bhoha bhakikwemukana papamu.
Pindulu lilobhe likiyuhwanika kuhuma kunane kubhwelo, lilobhe liibheghite handa lya liyegha lya likusi, lukiikwiniha mula mu nyumba hyoha yabhatamite.
Mbole hikiabwitukila hilibhi handa ndetelehe ya mwoto na hikipwilinganika na kutula unane mwa kila mundu.
Bhoha bhakimemekehwa Nhuki ghwa Chapanga na bhakiyanda kuyobhela mu nongelo nhanganganiko handa Nhuki ghwa Chapanga pakabhahotolite.
Na akwo ku Yelusalemu bhakibha Akaayahudi bhandu bhaantundamilite na kunnyitikila Chapanga, bhahumite kumilima hyoha ya munnima.
Pabhayuhwite lilobhe alyo, lumati lukulu lwa bhandu lukikwemukana papamu. Bhandu bhoha bhakibhughanikwa kiyaha kila yumo ywabhe kakiayuhwa pabhalongela mu nongelo yake yakabhelekitwi nayo.
Bhakibhughanikwa na kukangacha paakilongela, “Abha bhandu bhatubhayuhwa pabhalongela habhu ndo akolannima bha ku Galilaya chepa?
Yibha bhuli twabhoha tungubhayihwa pabhalongela kila mundu kwa nongelo yake yakabhelekitwe nalyo?
Twaamoo bhetu tuhuma ku Apati na ku Amedi na ku Aelamu; bhangi akolannima kuhuma ku Mesopotamia na ku Yudea na ku Kapodokia na ku Ponto na ku Asia,
ku Filigia na ku Pamfilia na ku Misili na mu mbande ya ku Libiya ugheghela na ku Kilene na amoo bhangi ahenja kuhuma ku Loma.
Akaayahudi na bhandu bhangi bhaalilungite na dini ya Akaayahudi, bhangi ahuma ku Kelete na ku Alabia. Twabhoha tunguayihwa bhandu abha paalongela mihalo mikulu ya Chapanga kwa nongelo yetu twabhene!”
Bhoha bhakibhughanikwa na kubhaghaya kunu paakwonyana, milando ayi fwambulo yake niki?
Peni bhangi bhakibhayuyuha paakilongela, “Bhandu abha alobhela ughimbi!”
Petili kangubhalandamiha bhandu

Peni Petili kakiyima papamu na bhala andumitumi mbinda mabhoko yimo na yumo na kakiyanda kualandamiha bhandu kwa lilobhe likulu pakiaghombela, “Maalongo bhangu Akaayahudi na mabhoha mwenga munntama apa pa Yelusalemu, mughayihwe maha malagho ghambala kulongela.
Kulyaghila bhandu abha bhalobhelana ng'obhe handa pamubhahwachila, kiyaha yibha malabhila muno ya saa ndatu.
Ngati nnando aghu ndo ghula ghuulondolitwe na mbuyi ghwa Chapanga ywakakemitwe Yoheli, pakilongela.”

content.text: Bhana bhenu alume na ahinja bhaalondola mihalo yangu,
Hata andumindumi bhangu adala kwa alume,
kwaabhegha mwahi na mwoto na lyohi linakutopa.
na mwehi ghwabhegha nkele handa mwahi
yikali na kuhika linjubha likulu lya ukulu ghwa Bambo.
Na apwo, ywoheli ywapala kuyupa kwa lihina lya Bambo, katalopoleghwa.’ ”

content: Petili kakighendelela kulongela, “Mwenga ma bhandu bha ku Isilaeli nnyihwe malagho agha mahamaha! Chapanga kakibhalangiha mwega kukita kangutenda lihengo maha kwa kukindila Yesu ghwa ku Nasaleti. Mabhene mungumanya kukita kwa kukindila Yesu kakitenda naho ndangalo kwa mwenga.
Kubhukana na unyakatiho ghwake mwene Chapanga kakilamula kwa kumanya kukita Yesu kangapukilitwe mumabhoko ghenu, mwenga mukinkoma kwa kualekela bhandu ahakata bhankome bhammambe.
Peni Chapanga kakinhyuha Yesu kuhuma kwa bhaahweghite kakimmuha mu ubhabho ghwa ntumba, kiyaha yingahotolitwi ng'obhe kukamulighwe na makakala gha kiho.
Kiyaha Daudi kakilongela kwa kya Yesu.”

content.text: Kiyaha kabhegha mukibhoko kyangu kya nnilo, ndaghaluka ng'obhe.
Na mmili ghwangu ghwatama mu uhyubhalilo.
Kiyaha ghwaghuleka ng'obhe uhuki ghwangu kumambe,
ebu ghwannekeha ng'obhe nng'anyimo ghwakwo kabhole kulindogholo.
Na ghwandenda nyelelwe paamegha papamu na ghwenga!’ ”

content: “Maalongo bhangu Makaaisilaeli, nungupala nibhaghombele hoto kukita tati ghwetu Daudi kakihwegha, na kukulilwa na lindogholo lyake libhegha apa mbaka lelo.
Peni kiyaha Daudi kakibha Mbuye ghwa Chapanga na kakimanya kukita Chapanga kakinlagha kwa kilapo kukita katantenda yumoo ywa ubheleko ghwake pakiteho kyake kya utabhala.
Daudi kakibhona kya kutali mihalo yaghenda kutenda Chapanga, na habhu kakikambuka ya kya uhyuko ghwa kilisto.

content: “Hinu, Chapanga kukinhyuha Yesu na twabhoha twenga ndo mayimiho bha ndendelo ayi.

Mbole ya Tate Chapanga kunkweha ngati katabhale papamu naywo, kakikingama Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kubhuka kwa Tate, katugheghela Nhuki ghwa Chapanga ywene Chapanga kakilagha ndo agha ghamughabhona na kughayihwa.
Kiyaha Daudi kakiyinulighwa ng'obhe kughenda kunane kwa Chapanga, peni mwene kakilongela.”

content: Petili kakighendelela kulongela “Hinu bhandu bhoha bha ku Isilaeli amanye nhalo aghu kukita. Chapanga kanntenda aywo Yesu, ywa yunbamanditi, kabhe Bambo na Kilisito Nkombohi.”
Hinu bhandu paayihwite mihalo ayi, bhakihomwa mumyoyo yabhe, bhakinkonya Petili na andumitumi bhangi, “Maalongo bhetu, hinu tutende niki?”

Petili kakiayanga, “Kila mundu kalipetule na kaghuleke ulemwa na kabatiswe kwa lihina lya Yesu kilisto, ngati mmokole ulekekeho ghwa ulemwa ghwenu, na mwenga maakamuhwa lilumbo lya Nhuki ghwa Chapanga.
Kiyaha naghilo ayi yikibha ya kya mwenga na bhana bhenu, na bhandu bhoha bhaatama kutali na mundu ywoheli ywakakemwa na Bambo Chapanga ghwetu.”
Kwa nganikiho ndangalo Petili kakiakanikiha pakilongela, “Mulilopohe na kibheleko aki kihakata!”
Linjubha lila bhandu atangalo bhakighayitikila malagho ghake na bhakibatiswa. Bhandu handa elufu ndatu bhakiyonjokeheka mulumati lula luunhyubhaliliti Chapanga.
Abha bhoha bhakighendelela kulihunda kwa andumitumi bha Yesu, kutama papamu kiulongo, kulyegha hilyo papamu na kunnyupa Chapanga.
Bhula ahyubhalilo pabhatamiti papamu manjubha ghoha
Andumitumi bhakitenda mihabho na naho ndangalo mbaka bhandu bhoha bhakikangacha muno na kunhokamila Chapanga.
Bhaanhyubhaliliti Chapanga bhoha bhakighendelela kutama papamu, na hilibhi hyabhe bhakitangatilana.
Bhakihemela hilibhi hyabhe na utopelo ghwabhe na bhakinng'abhila kila mundu handa pakapelelitwe.

Bhakighendelela kukongana papamu manjubha ghoha mu Kitutubhi kya Chapanga. Peni mu lisaa lya kulyegha hilyo, bhakikongana mu hitutubhi hyabhe na bhakililunga mu hilyo ahyo kwa uyelelo na mwoyo ghwa nga kingaka,
paakintika Chapanga, na kuanogheha bhandu bhoha. Kila linjubha Bambo kakiayonjokehela bhandu bha alopohitwe.
